current_suggestion.pitch: Your poker diet is heavy on GTO theory (GTO Wizard, GTO Lab, Alderman) but light on the live poker exploitative angle — Poker Cookies fills that gap with high-stakes live cash game hand analysis focused on reads, population tendencies, and deviations from GTO that are actually profitable in practice. The channel is run by a single coach who breaks down real hands with a methodical, non-hype style that complements rather than contradicts solver-based thinking. Format is solo analysis with clear reasoning, typically 15–30 minutes per video, at a depth that assumes you already understand the basics.
